scientific_question: Can one small permutation-equivariant observation/geometry-only model predict the pre-registered pair_depth_projection_only coefficient target for every opened fit cell, without a truth-defined active-tail selector, and then preserve the frozen matched-accuracy and cost gates under complete-trajectory leave-one-out evaluation?

primary_target.label: pair_depth_projection_only
primary_target.teacher: The exact CGLS detector-dual difference z4-z1 from the same deployment-visible observation and reported geometry.
primary_target.objective: For the frozen direction matrix D and projected contributions P=A A^T D, minimize ||c P - A A^T(z4-z1)||^2 with the frozen 1e-6 mean-Gram-diagonal ridge.
primary_target.normalization: Unit RMS with sign oriented to nonnegative inner product with the teacher projection.

complete_teacher_barrier.independent_recomputation_scope: Rebuild all 3700 direction rosters and primary coefficients from the sealed observations, geometry and exact CGLS z4-z1 teacher without importing the formal direction, solve or canonicalization helpers.
complete_teacher_barrier.barrier_pass_rule: Both implementations produce all 3700 finite primary targets, agree in physical dual/projection images within separately frozen numerical tolerances, preserve camera permutation equivariance and leave validation/test truth unread.
complete_teacher_barrier.failure_action: Record an inconclusive or negative engineering/scientific result and do not train a predictor from a partial or truth-selected target bundle.

outer_evaluation.embargo: The complete held-out trajectory, all of its frames, camera-count variants, perturbation factors and severities are absent from fit, normalization, model choice and stopping.

allowed: direction-local target, peer, depth-bin and angle-branch token
forbidden: field, full-gradient, interior-gradient or observation score

primary_model.name: shared_direction_token_deepset_v1
primary_model.architecture: A shared direction-token MLP receives direction-local observable summaries plus a mean-pooled Deep Sets camera context and emits one scalar coefficient per direction.
primary_model.optimizer: full-batch Adam followed by deterministic L-BFGS-B polish
primary_model.checkpoint_selection: final epoch only; no held-out checkpoint selection
primary_model.loss: fit-fold mean squared error in canonical fixed-target coefficient space with one fixed 1e-6 coefficient-L2 penalty

physical_replay.initializer: Predicted coefficient vector -> frozen direction mixture z -> one exact A^T lift -> frozen observable-only line search -> unchanged CGLS K1.

decision_gate.success_meaning: Only development-set complete-trajectory LOTO evidence for a minimal observation/geometry-only predictor on the opened PoolFire proxy.
decision_gate.failure_action: Close this fixed-target predictor route and do not rescue it with a larger network.

authorization.authorization_transition: Formal model fitting may begin only after the all-3700 formal teacher bundle and a separately implemented independent reconstruction both pass and are atomically sealed.
